title: Scrap of paper in your pocket
text:
Your own handwriting, but you don't remember writing it:

"Go up. Don't stop on any floor longer than you have to.
Read the rules. Not all of them are true."

title: Night guard's log, 13–14 June 1998
text:
02:10  Site engineer still upstairs. Pour continuing.
02:55  Phone rang again. Nobody there. I answered anyway. Always answer.
03:33  

(The rest of the page is blank. Someone has circled the time.)

Key box code = the time everything stopped.
